kyonki state aur cbse ke education pattern mein bahut jayada fark hota hai.jis chij ki high demand hai wahi subjects or syllabus honey chaiye upgrade karo education system ko dress code bhi ek hi rakho aur ye urdu sanskrit ya jo bhi dusri bhasha hain unko optional rakhey ki jo seekhna chahey wo seekhey compulsory na karey kyonki ye time consume karti hain.moral science and moral values ko jaruri tor par add karey aur jo teachers hai aur school administration hai wo weak aur back benchers bachchon par extra dhyaan de extra period le unkey liye weak subjects ke upar ye bachchey ki nahi teachers ki responsiblity hai ki kon bachcha kis subject mein weak hai to ussey konsey subject period extra lene hongey aur teacher har 2 mahiney mein ptm rakhey bachchey ki khubi aur weakness dono ko maabaap ke saamney rakhey school ke andar teacher hi bachchey ka mabaap hota hai to usi hisaab se sabhi bachchon ko ek samaan sikhsha dein koi bhedbhaav ke saath na padhaye aur sabhi stur ke bachchon ko school mein admission de kyonki issey bachchey ek dusrey ki gareebi ameeri sukh suvidha aur asuvidha ka fark samajh jayenge aur unkey beech achchey burey kam jyada ka gyaan aa jayega kisi ko kisi ka ghar chalaney ke liye maar pakad se teacher ko appoint na karey jinhey sahi mein kisi subject ka gyaan ho inhi ko teacher banaye na ke sirf tankha lene ke liye pehli baat iss desh mein sab apna
